agent: speckit.plan

# Purpose

Generate a QA Test Plan.

# Input

spec.md
Project Context

# Output

Generate testplan.md

Include:

Test Objectives
Scope
Out of Scope
Test Strategy
Test Types
Environment
Test Data
Entry Criteria
Exit Criteria
Risks
Assumptions
Dependencies
Deliverables
Timeline (if available)

Do not discuss implementation or project management activities outside QA.
